description: This file defines generic pagination classes for handling paginated data responses, including a PageMeta class for metadata and a Paginated<T> class for paginated collections.

classes.name: PageMeta
classes.description: Represents pagination metadata such as current page, page size, total items, and total pages.

classes.name: Paginated
classes.description: A generic class encapsulating a list of items along with pagination metadata.

methods.name: PageMeta.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PageMeta instance from a JSON map, extracting pagination info with default fallbacks.

methods.name: Paginated.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Paginated instance from a JSON map, transforming items with a provided fromJsonT function and extracting metadata.
